name: Axolotl
license: 1DesignTool 3D Library License — commercial website use and in-product embedding permitted; standalone file/model-pack redistribution prohibited.
educationalRole: A clearly named axolotl example for the general amphibian-class lesson only; not a Bangladesh-fauna claim.
modifications: Textures resized to a 512 px maximum and encoded as WebP at quality 82.
Geometry quantized using standard KHR_mesh_quantization; no WASM-based compression.
limitations: The model is code-built and described by its source as realistic, not photogrammetry.
External gills, feet and fins are separate overlapping meshes; the source notes close-up seams and a flat translucent fin.
Do not present it as a Bangladesh native-fauna example or redistribute the GLB as a standalone file.
